description: CoreDNS with L1 memory cache, redis_cache L2 cache and forward proxy metrics. Instance selection includes only targets with a successful current scrape; All expands to those instances. Based on the CoreDNS 1.7.0+ dashboard by ejkinger.

panels.title: Response cache
panels.description: All DNS responses over the selected time range and instances, split by cache source. L1 Hit includes memory-cache hits; Redis Hit includes Redis hits after an L1 miss. Cache Miss is total responses minus both hit counts, including uncached failures and responses that bypass caching. All response codes are included: cached negative or error answers count as hits, not misses.

panels.title: All upstreams unhealthy
panels.description: Rate of forwarding events when all upstream health checks are failing.

panels.title: L1 memory cache (hit ratio)
panels.description: Success and denial hits as fractions of all L1 cache requests. Misses subtract both hit types. DNSSEC uses the same cache counters in current CoreDNS.

panels.title: Upstream connection cache (hit ratio)
panels.description: Connection reuse, not DNS answer caching. Denominator is connection cache hits plus misses.

panels.title: Redis lookup rate
panels.description: L2 lookups after L1 misses. The request_duration_seconds_count histogram series counts all Redis lookup attempts, including errors. Only servers using redis_cache emit these metrics.

panels.title: Redis hit ratio
panels.description: Hits divided by Redis lookup attempts, not all DNS requests. Non-hits include cache misses, read failures and rejected entries. No data when no lookups occur. The zero fallback handles lazily created hit counters while requiring lookup metrics to exist; the positive denominator excludes idle periods.

panels.title: Redis lookup latency
panels.description: Time spent looking up Redis entries, including failed reads. Does not include upstream DNS latency.

panels.title: Redis errors / rejected entries
panels.description: Event counters are created lazily by redis_cache. Show zero only while Redis lookup metrics are present; a job without the plugin remains No data. Read/write errors are summed across reasons.
